_doc: EN 520:2004+A1:2009 board-type reference for the Building boards Tech. Details section (libs/lib_en520.py). Product designations come from S__Comments ('Type D E F H1 I R'); 'overrides' replaces that for products whose comment is missing or which are not EN 520 boards.

A.name: Standard board
A.req: Face suitable for gypsum plaster or decoration; base requirements only

E.name: Sheathing board
E.req: For external walls, not permanently exposed to weather. Total water absorption ≤ 10 %, water-vapour resistance factor µ ≤ 25

F.name: Improved core cohesion at high temperature
F.req: Core contains mineral fibres/additives; specimen must not break in the high-temperature core-cohesion test

H1.name: Reduced water absorption rate
H1.req: Total water absorption ≤ 5 %, surface absorption ≤ 180 g/m²

H2.name: Reduced water absorption rate
H2.req: Total water absorption ≤ 10 %, surface absorption ≤ 220 g/m²

H3.name: Reduced water absorption rate
H3.req: Total water absorption ≤ 25 %, surface absorption ≤ 300 g/m²

P.name: Base board
P.req: Face intended to receive gypsum plaster; may be perforated

R.name: Enhanced strength
R.req: Flexural breaking load ≥ 58·t N longitudinal, ≥ 24·t N transverse (t = thickness, mm)

glass_mat.note: Glass-mat gypsum board (GM): designated under EN 15283-1, not EN 520. The suffix letters have the same meaning as the EN 520 types; limits are set by EN 15283-1.

BBW__GYP__0035.note: Gypsum fibre board — outside the scope of EN 520. Rigidur boards are CE-marked under EN 15283-2 (Rigidur H: GF-C1-I-W2); check the DoP for this product's exact designation.

BBW__GYP__0097.note: Gypsum fibre board — outside the scope of EN 520 (CE marking under EN 15283-2). Designation as commonly declared for fermacell gypsum fibreboard; confirm on the DoP.

BBW__FIC__0099.note: Lightweight cement board reinforced with glass-fibre mesh — not an EN 520 product. CE-marked via European Technical Assessment ETA 22/0753.

BBW__FIC__0100.note: Cement board — not an EN 520 product. CE-marked via ETA-07/0173 (DIBt, EAD 210024-00-0504); classified category B per EN 12467.

BBW__FIC__0101.note: Cement board — not an EN 520 product. Knauf AQUAPANEL boards are CE-marked via a European Technical Assessment; check the DoP for the reference.

BBW__FIC__0103.note: Cement-based board — not an EN 520 product. CE-marked under EN 12467 (fibre-cement flat sheets).
